## Claim amendment · 2026-11-17T08:55Z

From L1-b REWORK 6943358263 on PR #34713 (M3, M4). This restates the Clause-② line of amendment 6941596951 and adds one file.

- File surface adds `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.pendingDraftsPulse-13139.test.tsx` (added at a33148bf).
- Clause-②: yes (widening: new locale keys, and two additive changes to the published `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` API: the optional `publishFromShellBar` prop and the optional second argument `opts.appSegment` of `onBuildMaterialized`; the only caller is `AiChatPage`). Seat ruling: a published package export widening gets a seat L2 at TIER_DEFAULT on that face; L1-b remains the review of record for the rest.
- i18n budget (seat ruling 08:40Z) for the five new `console.ai.pendingDrafts.*` key groups: waived on one condition. A pack-shaped namespace moves whole groups and their older siblings already live in the eager `locales/en.ts`, so splitting the group is worse than keeping it together. The keys may stay only if the PR body reports an i18n-locale-en reading under the ceiling after merging main. If the reading is over, the whole `console.ai.pendingDrafts` group moves to a pack-shaped namespace built by `createPackNamespace`, and the surface amends again.
